reuse.why: The furthest-from-zero expected-amount rule already exists in the tree (shared/schedules.ts preview, forecast-schedules.ts, schedule-template.ts) but the change neither calls nor extracts a shared function for it, writing the expression inline again.

duplication.why: The nested ternary in scheduleModel.toExternal is a verbatim copy of the preview-amount expression in shared/schedules.ts, adding a fourth copy of the rule.

placement.why: Computing the field in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts is the right layer for an API-shape addition.

scope.why: Only the API type, the model mapping and a focused test change.

maintainability.why: If the expected-amount rule changes, this copy must be found and updated alongside three others; a shared helper in shared/schedules.ts was the obvious move.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared furthest-from-zero helper exists in this tree to bypass (getScheduledAmount computes the average, a different rule); the issue is copying, not bypassing.

disguised_duplication.where: The expression in api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal is copied verbatim from shared/schedules.ts (preview amount), not renamed or reshaped.
